헛것.englishDescription: A state in which one's efforts fail to pay off.
헛것.englishExpression: being in vain; coming to nothing

헛것.definitionKo: 신체나 정신이 약해져 착각이 일어나, 없는데 있는 것처럼, 또는 다른 것처럼 보이는 물체.
헛것.englishDescription: An object that looks like another or seems to exist although it is not real due to an illusion stemming from mental and physical weakness.

현수막.englishDescription: A cloth draping down in a theatre, etc.

현수막.definitionKo: 선전하는 글이나 주장하여 외치는 글 등을 적어서 드리운 천이나 막.
현수막.englishDescription: A cloth or screen draped with an advertisement or a protest message on it.

협력하다.englishDescription: To join forces to help each other.

협조적.englishDescription: Joining forces to harmonize with one another.

협조적.definitionKo: 힘을 합쳐 서로 조화를 이루는 것.
협조적.englishDescription: A state of joining forces to harmonize with one another.

호구.definitionKo: 호적에 나와 있는 집과 식구의 수.
호구.englishDescription: The number of households and family members in the family register.
호구.englishExpression: number of households; number of household members

호구.definitionKo: 호랑이의 입이라는 뜻으로, 매우 위험하고 아슬아슬한 처지나 상황.
호구.englishDescription: An extremely dangerous and risky state or situation, literally meaning the mouth of a tiger.

호구.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 순진하고 다루기가 쉬워 이용하기 좋은 사람.
호구.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who is easily taken advantage of because he/she is naïve and stupid.

호구.definitionKo: 입에 풀칠을 한다는 뜻으로, 가난하여 겨우 끼니를 이음.
호구.englishDescription: An act of making ends meet, literally meaning putting glue on one's mouth.
호구.englishExpression: keeping the wolf from the door; eking out

호랑이.definitionKo: 누런 갈색의 몸에 검은 줄무늬가 있고, 다른 동물을 잡아먹고 사는 몸집이 큰 동물.
호랑이.englishDescription: A big, carnivorous animal that has yellowish brown coat and black stripes.
(figurative) A very ferocious and fearsome person.

호시탐탐.definitionKo: 남의 것을 빼앗기 위해 상황을 살피며 가만히 기회를 엿봄.
호시탐탐.englishDescription: An act of watching a situation and waiting quietly for an opportunity to take another's possessions.
호시탐탐.englishExpression: watching for an opportunity; being on alert for an opportunity

호위되다.definitionKo: 어떤 대상이 곁에 있는 사람에 의해 보호되고 지켜지다.
호위되다.englishDescription: To be accompanied by another person to be protected and guarded by him/her.
호위되다.englishExpression: be guarded; be escorted; be safeguarded

호주머니가 넉넉하다[두둑하다/든든하다].englishDescription: To have much money in one's hands.
호주머니가 넉넉하다[두둑하다/든든하다].englishExpression: have enough in your pocket[have a thick/full pocket]

호평하다.englishDescription: To evaluate someone or something positively.
호평하다.englishExpression: comment favorably; give a favorable review

혹세무민.englishDescription: An act of disrupting the world and deceiving people by seducing them.
혹세무민.englishExpression: deluding the world and deceiving the people

혼인.englishDescription: A state in which a man and woman become a married couple.

혼절하다.definitionKo: 큰 충격이나 고통을 받아 갑자기 정신이 아득하고 어지러워 정신을 잃고 쓰러지다.
혼절하다.englishDescription: To lose consciousness and collapse, feeling dizzy and dazed suddenly due to a great shock or pain.

홀몸.definitionKo: 아내나 남편 또는 형제가 없는 사람.
홀몸.englishDescription: A person without a wife or husband, or siblings.

홀홀.definitionKo: 작은 새나 나비 등이 잇따라 날개를 치며 가볍게 나는 모양.
홀홀.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of birds, etc., fluttering their wings and flying lightly one after another.

홀홀.definitionKo: 가는 눈이나 종이, 털 등이 가볍게 날리는 모양.
홀홀.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of snow, paper, fur, etc., flying lightly.
A word describing the motion of running or moving as if to fly lightly.

홀홀.definitionKo: 작고 가벼운 물건을 자꾸 멀리 던지거나 뿌리는 모양.
홀홀.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of repeatedly sprinkling a light object or throwing it far.

홀홀.definitionKo: 먼지나 작은 부스러기 등을 잇따라 가볍게 떠는 모양.
홀홀.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of continuously shaking off dust or crumbs, etc., lightly,

홀홀.definitionKo: 옷을 가볍게 벗어 버리거나 벗기는 모양.
홀홀.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of throwing off one's or another's clothes without hesitation.

홀홀.definitionKo: 뜨거운 물 등을 조금씩 자꾸 마시는 모양.
홀홀.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of drinking water or soup, etc., little by little, repeatedly.
A word describing the motion of fire burning little by little.
A word describing the motion of blowing one's breath on something little by little, repeatedly.

홍수.definitionKo: 비가 많이 내려서 갑자기 크게 불어난 강이나 개천의 물.
홍수.englishDescription: The water in a river or stream that has suddenly risen due to a heavy rain and that is moving quickly.

홍수.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 사람이나 사물이 한꺼번에 많이 쏟아져 나오는 상태.
홍수.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which a large number of people or things pour out at once.

확립되다.definitionKo: 생각이나 체계 등이 굳고 확실하게 서다.
확립되다.englishDescription: For a thought or system, etc., to become firm and clear.
확립되다.englishExpression: be established; be built; be forged

환담하다.englishDescription: To have a friendly, agreeable conversation.
환담하다.englishExpression: have a friendly talk; chat enjoyably

활엽수.definitionKo: 감나무, 오동나무, 참나무 등과 같이 잎이 평평하고 넓은 나무.
활엽수.englishDescription: A tree such as the persimmon, paulownia, and oak, whose leaves are broad and flat.

회고록.definitionKo: 지나간 일을 돌이켜 생각하며 적은 기록.
회고록.englishDescription: A record written based on one's reflection on past events.

회동하다.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 일정한 목적을 가지고 한데 모이다.
회동하다.englishDescription: For many people to gather in one place for a certain purpose.

회수하다.englishDescription: To take back what one has given or lent to another.

획.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of an object moving or passing swiftly.

획.definitionKo: 바람이 갑자기 세게 부는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
획.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of wind blowing wildly, suddenly.
A word describing the motion of throwing or shaking off something powerfully, suddenly.

획.definitionKo: 휘파람을 짧고 힘 있게 부는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
획.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of blowing a whistle powerfully, briefly.

획.definitionKo: 글씨를 쓰거나 그림을 그릴 때, 붓으로 한 번 그은 줄이나 점.
획.englishDescription: A line or point drawn with a single movement of the brush in caligraphy or painting.

획.definitionKo: 글씨를 쓰거나 그림을 그릴 때, 붓으로 한 번 그은 줄이나 점을 세는 단위.
획.englishDescription: The unit of counting lines or points drawn with a single movement of the brush in caligraphy or painting.

획득.englishDescription: An act of earning and possessing something.

횡재.definitionKo: 아무런 노력을 들이지 않고 뜻밖에 재물을 얻음. 또는 그 재물.
횡재.englishDescription: An act of acquiring wealth unexpectedly without making any effort; or such wealth.

효험.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 작용의 좋은 보람이나 결과.
효험.englishDescription: A state in which a certain task or action bears fruit or produces a good result.

후들후들하다.definitionKo: 팔다리나 몸이 자꾸 크게 떨리다. 또는 팔다리나 몸을 자꾸 크게 떨다.
후들후들하다.englishDescription: For one's arms or body to tremble wildly in a repeated manner; or to shake one's arms or body wildly in a repeated manner.

후불.definitionKo: 일이 끝난 뒤나 물건을 받은 뒤에 돈을 냄.
후불.englishDescription: An act of paying after the completion of a job or receipt of an object.

훈시.definitionKo: 윗사람이 아랫사람에게 맡은 일을 처리할 때에 주의할 점을 일러 줌.
훈시.englishDescription: An act of giving an order or request to one's subordinate regarding matters that require attention when handling one's own mission.
An act of teaching or persuading another.

훈훈하다.definitionKo: 날씨나 온도가 견디기 좋을 만큼 따뜻하다.
훈훈하다.englishDescription: The weather or temperature being bearably warm.

훈훈하다.definitionKo: 마음을 부드럽게 녹여 주는 따뜻함이 있다.
훈훈하다.englishDescription: Having warmth that softens the heart.
A smell filling the air, etc.

훤하다.definitionKo: 앞이 탁 트여 매우 넓고 시원스럽다.
훤하다.englishDescription: A view being sweeping and unobstructed.

훤하다.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 내용이나 사정이 확실하고 분명하다.
훤하다.englishDescription: Something being transparent, obvious or quite predictable.
Having an extremely pleasing, neat, attractive appearance.

훤하다.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 대상에 대해 잘 알고 있다.
훤하다.englishDescription: Having an accurate and deep knowledge about a certain task or object.

휘적거리다.definitionKo: 걸을 때에 두 팔을 자꾸 휘젓다.
휘적거리다.englishDescription: To move one's arms back and forth repeatedly while walking.

흡연자.englishDescription: A person who smokes a cigarette

힐끔대다.definitionKo: 눈을 옆으로 돌려 자꾸 슬쩍슬쩍 쳐다보다.
힐끔대다.englishDescription: To direct the eyes sideways and look furtively at something repeatedly.

힘주다.englishDescription: To focus one's power or energy on a single thing.
